meta.notes: M4 weapons-2 head start: wasteland junk, the plan's own example (Kevin from Accounting swings a briefcase). Live from W-Q. W-T (the pitch deck's #4, 'weapons with verbs'): it is THROWN, not swung. At the end of the wind-up it leaves the hand at the thrower's speed plus the 'Throw speed' slider (16 m/s), aimed at the nearest rider up to reach.sM (14 m) ahead and reach.dM (3 m) to either side, and bursts into paperwork on whoever it meets, or where it lands. One throw and it is gone. It can still be snatched in the wind-up, from arm's length only. Crude starting numbers, [default].
